item.title: Re: Screams disappeared
item.content:encoded:
The forums are sorted by most recent post, and the idea forum gets pretty busy. It’s likely just on the next page.

As is recommended in the stickied Rules thread, you can reach out to people on the Butterfly Squad Roster in order to get eyes on an idea, or join IRC for real-time crit.

item.title: Screams disappeared
